name: servicebridge
description: Convenience scripts; each app keeps its own dependencies.

scripts.check:api: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:web
